name: Sales Matrix
title: Sales Matrix
description: Cross-tab tables with color scales, in the manner of Tableau's highlight tables. Click a column heading to sort the rows by it; click a cell to drill down.

parameters.name: year
parameters.label: Year
parameters.optionsSql: SELECT DISTINCT year FROM sales ORDER BY 1 DESC

datasets.name: catq
datasets.sql: SELECT category, quarter, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY category, quarter ORDER BY category, quarter

datasets.name: geo
datasets.sql: SELECT region, country, quarter, round(sum(revenue)) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY region, country, quarter ORDER BY region, country, quarter

datasets.name: margin
datasets.sql: SELECT segment, category, round(100.0 * (sum(revenue) - sum(cost)) / sum(revenue), 1) AS margin FROM sales WHERE year = :year GROUP BY segment, category ORDER BY segment, category
